description: This file is a shell script implementing a test suite for the 'git checkout --patch' functionality. It contains setup procedures, multiple test cases utilizing git commands, and verification steps to test how git handles patch application with various options, staged and unstaged changes, deletion, path limiting, and specific revision checkout.

methods.name: set_and_save_state
methods.description: Sets up the working directory, index, and HEAD states, and saves the current state for later verification.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executing the provided commands and verifying outcomes.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Simulates user input or command lines for testing patch application.

methods.name: verify_saved_state
methods.description: Verifies that the saved state matches the current state of the files.

methods.name: verify_state
methods.description: Verifies the current state of files against expected states.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for specific output strings in command outputs.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the directory, index, or HEAD to a specific state for testing.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets commands to run after tests are completed, such as cleanup operations.
